assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single original premium tarot CARD BACK illustration for the FATE dark-fantasy consumer app, not a mockup or website. Portrait 2:3 composition, completely flat straight-on edge-to-edge print artwork, no surrounding tabletop, no perspective, no lettering, no words or numbers. Create an extraordinarily refined engraved celestial observatory portal: luminous aged gold and champagne filigree, an astrolabe and crescent moon suspended at the center, an intricately painted deep midnight-teal and indigo nebula, delicate tiny stars, two symmetrical tall Gothic Art Deco columns and quiet architectural arches. Foil-etched gold linework combined with detailed hand-painted atmospheric mist and antique vellum engraving, tactile ink and brushed-metal details. Restrained luxurious collector's edition, subtle chiaroscuro, soft internal light, strong symmetry and calm negative space. A narrow ornamental gold border fully inset from every image edge; corners remain dark navy. Beautifully illustrated and materially rich, not a sparse programmatic icon, not a purple swirl, not flashy neon, not a playing-card suit symbol. Keep the center and ornament legible at mobile tarot-card size. Original design, no contemporary tarot-deck reproduction, no logos, no watermarks.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original seamless-looking internal nebula/mist texture for a WebGL magical crystal orb, square edge-to-edge image, no UI or object frame. A beautifully hand-painted volumetric cloud field floating in profound midnight blue darkness: broad soft layers of smoky teal, petroleum green, muted indigo, tiny champagne-gold light veins, one soft diffuse inner glow. Elegant mysterious old-world dark-fantasy oil painting, cinematic chiaroscuro, tangible velvet fog, translucency and overlapping cloud layers with deep dark voids between. LOW frequency broad silky clouds, smooth gradations and delicate fine wisps; enough structured variation across all quadrants for subtle animated refraction. At least half of image remains very dark navy. Avoid planet surfaces, marble, pebbles, hard ridges, harsh high-frequency details, busy stars, bright points, spirals, purple vortices, neon saturation, explosions, any text, logos, borders, card shapes or glass sphere. This is only the raw mist field; the application renders the glass, rim lighting and rings in real time. Original fantasy illustration.
